title: RFC-EDGE-009 — market microstructure and economic edge, registered

tracks.ACTIVE: 1 s entries with intraday holds; the registered objective is three executed trades a day across the aggregate universe, never forced
tracks.QUALITY: 5-minute to daily clock; its own floor is 0.05 trades a day and it is judged separately, never pooled with ACTIVE

ladder.name: information
ladder.rule: the feature must order the forward return (|Spearman IC| >= 0.01, n >= 500)

ladder.name: gross edge
ladder.rule: mean gross move in bps must be positive on the pooled sample

ladder.name: cost survival
ladder.rule: mean gross >= the measured round-trip cost of the venue/asset, in bps

ladder.name: admission margin
ladder.rule: mean gross >= 1.5 x round-trip cost (the frozen safety multiple)

ladder.name: capacity
ladder.rule: the measured book must absorb the order size inside the barrier; failing it is CAPACITY_KILLED

ladder.name: frequency
ladder.rule: the structure must offer >= 3 executed opportunities per day (ACTIVE); failing it is FREQUENCY_KILLED

hypotheses.title: quote imbalance is big enough to pay a taker round trip
hypotheses.statement: the book's own imbalance (bid vs ask size at the touch, and its change) predicts the mid move over 1/5/60 s by more than the venue's round-trip taker cost, so the prediction is executable by a taker order
hypotheses.falsified_if: the best measured mean gross move at any horizon is below the measured round-trip cost for that asset
hypotheses.data_requirement: forward book_ticker at quote level (no historical substitute exists)

hypotheses.title: the fee schedule is the binding constraint, not the signal
hypotheses.statement: the same measured gross move clears the barrier at a venue whose taker fee is lower, so the venue choice (not the model) is what blocks the edge
hypotheses.falsified_if: no compared venue brings the round-trip cost at or below the measured gross move, including the venue with the lowest researched taker fee
hypotheses.data_requirement: measured spread + the published fee schedules already registered
hypotheses.decided_at: F2 (cost survival) with V3 venue scenarios
hypotheses.note: a venue change is a governance decision; this measures, it does not adopt

hypotheses.title: the measured book can absorb our order size inside the barrier
hypotheses.statement: at the registered order size the captured book offers enough notional inside the barrier-implied impact, so the modelled cost is not a fiction
hypotheses.falsified_if: the notional available within the barrier-implied price band is below the runtime's minimum order notional
hypotheses.data_requirement: forward depth snapshots (10 levels) per symbol and market

hypotheses.title: open interest with price is exploitable on a slower clock
hypotheses.statement: the quadrant 'price down and open interest up' carries a positive forward move large enough to pay the round trip at a 5-minute horizon
hypotheses.falsified_if: no quadrant cell reaches a positive mean gross move at or above the round-trip cost, or the sample is below the registered floor
hypotheses.data_requirement: forward open interest + mid at 5-minute resolution
hypotheses.decided_at: F1/F2 with an explicit sample floor

hypotheses.title: three executed trades a day is reachable by a positive structure
hypotheses.statement: a structure whose expected move clears the barrier occurs at least three times a day across the aggregate universe, so the ACTIVE objective is a strategy question and not an arithmetic impossibility
hypotheses.falsified_if: the measured count of barrier-clearing opportunities per day is below the registered 3.0, no trade being forced to reach it
hypotheses.data_requirement: the same quote panel, counted without a performance filter

hypotheses.title: a taker entry pays no more than the measured spread and impact
hypotheses.statement: the price a taker order actually pays, measured against the mid at the decision instant, matches the modelled spread plus impact component, so the cost model is not systematically optimistic
hypotheses.falsified_if: the measured execution shortfall exceeds the modelled spread+impact component by more than the published tolerance
hypotheses.data_requirement: forward tape (agg_trade with aggressor side) + book_ticker
hypotheses.decided_at: measured, then compared to the model; not an admission filter

hypotheses.title: negative control: the pipeline does not manufacture an edge
hypotheses.statement: the identical pipeline, fed a feature destroyed by a deterministic shuffle inside each day, produces no cost-surviving edge
hypotheses.falsified_if: the negative control reaches the positive classification, which would invalidate every other result in this package
hypotheses.decided_at: must end COST_KILLED or NO_GROSS_EDGE or NO_INFORMATION
hypotheses.note: FALSE_SUCCESS guard: a positive control here stops the package

consumed_holdouts.what: the pre-registered decisive window of the EDGE-07 thrust book
a cross-section of six symbols never measured before
consumed_holdouts.symbols: AAVEUSDT, UNIUSDT, KSMUSDT, SNXUSDT, CRVUSDT, SUSHIUSDT

declared_limitations: profitability of any book: promotion is NONE and no order is sent
anything about liquidity outside the 4.16 h the forward capture covers
anything about the perp trade flow: this environment delivered zero perp aggTrade messages (SRC-15/SRC-18) and the absence is declared, never substituted
anything about realised maker fills: no venue in this project has a measured fill model
anything about markets the runtime excludes (derivatives are information, not product)
negative_control_rule: E-07 runs the identical pipeline on a feature destroyed by a deterministic shuffle; if it is classified positive, every other result of this package is void
